title: 'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino 's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ) light novel announced additional cast Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Monster Hunter Outlanders Game Launches on October 29
content: The official website for CAPCOM 's Monster Hunter Outlanders , a new game based on its Monster Hunter action game franchise , announced on Tuesday that the game will launch for iOS and Android devices on October 29. The game's mainland China version is scheduled for 2027.
author: ANN

title: Tomohiro Hata Performs Live-Action Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Series' Theme Song
content: NHK announced on Tuesday that Tomohiro Hata will perform the theme song "Fragments" for the live-action series of Yūki Kodama 's Ao no Hana, Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita' Ends with 6th Volume
content: Publishing company Square Enix announced on Wednesday that Mochimaru Sakaki 's Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kouryaku Site" wo Mireru Sekai de Jiyuu ni Ikimasu ( The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ) light novel will end…
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Piece Anime Confirms New Episodes to Return in 2027
content: The Elbaph arc of the One Piece anime debuted in Japan on April 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the arc. Toei Animation and One Piece anime producer Ryūta Koike announced in October 2025 that the anime was reducing its annual episode output to a maximum of 26 episodes moving forward starting in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Hirayasumi Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo, Main Visual
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Keigo Shinzou 's Hirayasumi manga revealed the main cast, a main visual (pictured) and a teaser promotional video on Tuesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on NHK-G in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hirayasumi Anime Unveils Teaser, Key Visual, Cast
content: Viz Media revealed a new teaser trailer, a new key visual, and the cast for the anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 3 Masterpiece Anime of 2026 That Are Written by Women
content: The Summer 2026 anime season has almost ended, and Fall is here, which means there are already nine months to look back on this year and see what it has produced in the anime industry.

title: Amata Games' Shinjuku Anomaly Game Reveals September 30 Launch in Trailer
content: Amata Games revealed on Monday that its Shinjuku Anomaly horror visual novel game will launch for PC via Steam on September 30. The company streamed a trailer: You have taken on a part-time job photographing anomalies that lurk in Shinjuku at night.
author: ANN

title: South Park Brings Back Butters With New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content: South Park is coming back this week with a brand new episode, and the first look at Season 29’s next new entry is putting Butters back front and center. South Park Season 29 kicked off its run this Fall with a major change to its title.
author: ComicBook
